mapper.sql: id, employee_id, employee_code, employee_name, department_name, leave_type, from_date, to_date, total_days, reason, status, reviewed_by, reviewer_note, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_requests ( employee_id, employee_code, employee_name, department_name, leave_type, from_date, to_date, total_days, reason, status ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{employeeCode}, #{employeeName}, #{departmentName}, #{leaveType}, #{fromDate}, #{toDate}, #{totalDays}, #{reason}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.update: UPDATE leave_requests SET status = 'APPROVED', reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewer_note = #{reviewerNote}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE leave_requests SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewer_note = #{reviewerNote}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM leave_requests WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM leave_requests
ORDER BY
employee_id employee_code employee_name department_name leave_type from_date to_date total_days status reviewed_at created_at
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leave_requests WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'PENDING'
